I grow beans here because they do well in our rains and help the soil. I do not buy chemical fertilizer for beans — it is too costly and beans fix their own nitrogen — but I will put manure on the plot before planting. I keep my own seed from last harvest, and my family will do all the work since the plot is small enough for us to manage. We rely only on the rains in Mangochi; there is no water for irrigation here.
